properties.name: telegram.bot.enabled
properties.description: Start Telegram long polling and the posting worker. Off by default and always off in the demo profile.

properties.name: telegram.bot.token
properties.description: Bot token from @BotFather. Provide via the TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN environment variable.

properties.name: telegram.bot.admins
properties.description: Bot administrators: Telegram @usernames and/or numeric user ids.

properties.name: telegram.bot.public-registration
properties.description: Initial value of whether anyone may connect a channel.

properties.name: telegram.bot.default-timezone
properties.description: Timezone assigned to newly connected channels.
